criterion: Feedback / screen matches what will be saved
description: After a newer save on an untouched field, the edit form keeps showing the stale value (Priority P2) while the summary line and card show P0. Nothing says that untouched fields will not be sent, so the person cannot tell whether saving will revert Juniper's change.
expected: Untouched fields follow the latest version automatically, or the stale field is marked 'changed by Juniper to P0; not part of your save'.
actual: Form P2, summary P0, with only the general notice
suggested_fix: Auto-rebase untouched fields when context changes, keeping only touched fields as draft; reserve the explicit rebase button for touched fields.

description: When different Actors changed different fields, the newer-save notice credits all of them to the last author: 'Theo Lindqvist · human saved a newer status, tags', although Juniper changed the status.
expected: 'Juniper changed the status; Theo Lindqvist changed the tags.'
actual: One name for all newer fields
suggested_fix: Group newer fields by the History event author that last touched each field.

description: The notice joins raw field keys ('a newer status, tags', 'assignee') instead of the form labels and proper list grammar.
suggested_fix: Map field keys to form labels and join with 'and'.
